contract.name: Navigation
contract.description: Contract for navigating through the ordered pages of the educational book.

capability.name: Navigation
capability.responsibility: Control logical movement through the ordered pages of the book.

rules: Navigation operates on the logical order of pages.
The current page is identified by a stable page identifier.
The first page cannot move to a previous page.
The last page cannot move to a next page.
Navigation does not load image resources.
Navigation does not control narration playback.
Navigation does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
Navigation exposes WHAT movement is requested, not HOW movement is implemented.

errors.PAGE_NOT_FOUND: The requested page identifier does not exist.
errors.NAVIGATION_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: The requested navigation operation exceeds the available page boundaries.
errors.NAVIGATION_NOT_INITIALIZED: Navigation has not been initialized with a valid book.
